choices.witness: Stay with her. Don't blink.
choices.trickster: Turn her terror into a joke sharp enough to break the spell.
choices.devourer: Open your palms. Take her nightmare into them.

choices.witness: Speak the truth she won't touch.
choices.trickster: Tease the mask until it slips.
choices.devourer: Carry the denial for her. Let her rest in the lie.

choices.witness: Tell him he's shattering.

choices.devourer: Take the burden off his shoulders and onto yours.

choices.witness: Name the storm before she throws it.
choices.trickster: Egg her on. Turn impulse into play.
choices.devourer: Absorb the fallout. Let her burn, not the others.

choices.description: Redchurch whispered for the first time

choices.witness: Show her you see the fracture.

choices.devourer: Offer yourself up as the one at fault.

choices.witness: Say the thing no one else dares.

choices.witness: Meet her eyes in both reflections.

choices.witness: Speak the pattern aloud.

choices.witness: Tell her she's hiding.

choices.witness: Call her intentions by name.
choices.trickster: Push her further—see what she becomes.
choices.devourer: Ground her with your own body, your own certainty.

choices.witness: Tell him the truth: it's killing him.
choices.trickster: Turn the pressure into momentum.
choices.devourer: Let his devotion feed on yours.

choices.witness: Observe every detail. Memorize who they are.
choices.trickster: Turn the calm into shared giddiness.
choices.devourer: Give your peace to the person who needs it most.

choices.witness: See him clearly. Don't soften it.
choices.trickster: Mock the betrayal before it wounds.
choices.devourer: Take the blame for missing the signs.

choices.description: Yuul tries one last time to warn them

choices.devourer: Consume the warning. Carry its consequence alone.

choices.witness: Name her fear right to her face.

choices.devourer: Offer to carry her conviction for a while.

choices.witness: Acknowledge the imbalance.
choices.trickster: Provoke intimacy through chaos.
choices.devourer: Anchor her even if it burns you.

choices.witness: Ask him what he saw.
choices.trickster: Pretend you saw it too, spin a new story.
choices.devourer: Absorb his terror with a steady voice.

choices.description: The Trine stands on the edge of collapse
choices.witness: Describe the shape of the fall.
choices.trickster: Invert the fall into flight.
choices.devourer: Offer your resonance as the sacrifice needed to hold them together.

choices.description: Maeve senses the Seeress watching her

choices.trickster: Mock the omen. Steal its gravity.

choices.trickster: Cut the tension with irreverence.

choices.trickster: Push the harmony into laughter and movement.
choices.devourer: Anchor the harmony with your presence so it lasts longer.
